tldr: Mercury through the 10th house clarifies career, visibility, reputation, pressure, and ambition.
body:
When Mercury moves through your 10th house, it puts language around career, visibility, reputation, pressure, ambition, authority, and how you are being seen. You may notice how much attention is on your responsibilities, your public role, or the direction you are trying to build.

Something may need to be said, decided, written, questioned, or understood. It can help you name the question, make the call, or sort through the moving pieces.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for making a visible choice with more intention.

The caution: Watch for overthinking the situation until the simple next step disappears. The risk is measuring your whole self by what is productive, impressive, or approved.

Mercury moves through this house for a few weeks. Use the mental activity for clarity. Say the thing plainly, then let the answer tell you what comes next.
